hooks.text: 每轮仅有10步，以连续吃子维持连击并累乘分数
hooks.excerpt: You only have 10 moves. Every capture counts for scoring. Build huge combo chains, multiply your score, and push your run as far as possible.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 构筑可围绕连击延长、棋子专精、走法改变与区域计分展开
hooks.excerpt: Create runs focused on: combo extensions piece specialization movement changing upgrades zone based scoring boosts more enemy pieces more moves end combo effects
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Boss会直接改写棋子冷却、可移动棋种或出子顺序
hooks.excerpt: Boss encounters introduce mechanics that disrupt your strategy and force you to adapt on the fly. Every few stages, the game changes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自制图形和动画受到明确赞赏。

excerpts.excerpt: big ups for all the homemade graphic design and animations.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 任务在UI中不够醒目，容易被忘记。

excerpts.excerpt: I often forget about the quests because they don't stand out enough in the UI.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分任务描述过长，不便快速阅读。

excerpts.excerpt: some quest descriptions can be a bit too wordy
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: Boss迫使玩家调整策略，使每局保持变化。

excerpts.excerpt: Bosses keep runs interesting by forcing you to adapt your strategy
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 构筑种类优秀，协同成型后很难放下。

excerpts.excerpt: The build variety is excellent, and once the synergies start coming together, the game becomes hard to put down.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
